Nanjing University's trial generative-AI guidance from the Undergraduate School applies to undergraduate students.
Nanjing University undergraduate guidance prohibits using generative-AI tools to write key content in papers, assignments, reports, or works.

For listed allowed-use contexts, Nanjing University undergraduate guidance permits generative-AI tool use only after written signed or electronically signed consent from the course instructor or thesis/project supervisor.
For undergraduate thesis or project use of AI, Nanjing University guidance requires advance written application and a dedicated AI-use statement page when submitting the work.

Nanjing University undergraduate guidance allows generative AI to assist with topic research, literature search, material organization, and reference formatting, but requires students to assess generated information and forbids directly copying generated content to replace independent research.

Nanjing University undergraduate guidance says violations of the generative-AI rules may lead to measures such as warnings, lowered grades, cancellation of undergraduate thesis defense eligibility, or degree-related consequences when academic misconduct is involved.

Nanjing University undergraduate guidance says students should use nationally registered AI services and forbids uploading data, images, or other sensitive information from confidential papers or reports to AI platforms unless specially approved by relevant departments.
